previous_experiences: Founded Remotely Good (RemotelyGood.us), an AI-powered social-impact job board and newsletter, launched via Kickstarter circa 2019–2021; grew to 2,000+ Substack subscribers and featured in Forbes.
Launched Social Impact SF, a Bay Area community events group, which grew to 1,300+ members shortly after its July 2025 launch.

bio_text: Theresa Anoje is the San Francisco-based founder of Remotely Good, an AI-powered job board and newsletter connecting people with remote and hybrid roles at nonprofits, campaigns, advocacy groups, and government agencies. She also founded Social Impact SF, a fast-growing Bay Area community for civic-minded technologists and changemakers. A self-described non-engineer, she leverages AI tools to build civic products and believes remote access is key to democratizing participation in social-impact work.
